name: Kuraibito
source: Kotone Takashina, Mami Yuzuki and Yuuri Kanou are three high-school students members of the Mystery Club of their school looking for spooky events happening around. One day, after she discovered via Internet about a ruined place located in a forest near of their town, Kotone decide to check it with her friends. However, a sudden downpour take the three girls by surprise and instead of ruins, they discovered an European-styled mansion who belongs to a mysterious man and his young twin sisters. The man, Shuuya Houjou, allows them to stay inside of his house until the downpour ends, but the three girls will soon learn about the dreadful secret hidden inside of the mansion...
translation:
高阶琴音、柚木真美与狩野悠里是同一所高中的三名学生，也是学校神秘研究部的成员，经常四处寻找诡异事件。一天，琴音在网上得知城镇附近的森林中有一片废墟，决定与朋友们一同前往调查。

突如其来的暴雨令三名少女措手不及。她们没有找到废墟，却发现了一座欧式宅邸，里面住着一名神秘男子与他年幼的双胞胎妹妹。男子名叫宝条秋夜，允许她们留在屋内避雨。然而，三名少女很快便会发现，这座宅邸中隐藏着一个骇人的秘密……
